understood_as: Integrate unchanged frozen first-system plus GT14D second-system layers in original page coordinates, validate collisions and inspect readability; no new notation or source corrections.
assembly: Copy y<700 from frozen GT13A6 two-system alpha and y>=700 from GT14D combined alpha; require the full union to equal GT14D combined alpha byte for byte. This boundary lies in empty inter-system space and does not move either system.
collision: Use independent frozen event/header/chord/tie masks and conservative actual-alpha staff bands as notation obstacles; never subtract lyrics from notation to infer no collision. Intentional staff/head/stem/beam/ledger contacts remain separately described rather than called unexpected.
first_lyrics: Load frozen 40 lyric components, apply only the previously frozen GT13A5 integer displacements; require union byte equality with frozen local lyric alpha. No new glyph rasterization or layout search.
second_lyrics: Reuse 14 frozen syllables plus all 6 owner-confirmed extenders.
rules: Zero text/text and text/notation alpha contacts, zero cross-system component contacts or clipping, preserved coordinate registration and existing 0.5px head criterion. Do not fix discovered deficiencies in this validation run.
reference_policy: Original Bb raster only; no A/G reference page access or retuning.
visual_policy: Inspect frozen actual integrated PNG and native G low-register details. Agent inspection only, not independent optical validation.
